Estimated Maintenance Premium on Lifecycle-Exposed Assets

Compares average CPH/CPM of assets at or past lifecycle threshold vs healthy mid-life assets (age 3–7yr, <70% of hours/miles threshold) of the same type. The delta × annual usage = estimated excess maintenance cost incurred by not replacing on schedule.
